terms.quote: Noncommercial, off under the corporate profile until licence-cleared: blocklist.de, CINS, ET compromised IPs, GreenSnow and DataPlane (A1 BR16), VoIPBL, and the FireHOL level1 aggregate (it embeds noncommercial upstreams such as DShield).

update.notes: Quote: binding council text (P149 cond 2); research C0389 terms 'Free for non-commercial use; attribute source' (verified_live 200; served as text/html, no validators). LOW fidelity, special-purpose entries dropped at load. Used by ip_blocklists.
update.licensed_alternative: The open feeds of ip_blocklists (Spamhaus DROP/ASN-DROP, abuse.ch Feodo Tracker and SSLBL, IPsum, Binary Defense) keep running; a licence_allow entry recording the operator's written permission enables this feed.

notes: Owned by batch p1-G02-2 (P149). Downloaded whole by the dataset manager (conditional GET, validation) and matched locally: no value is ever sent. Never redistributed outside the team (P149 cond 2).
